==Biography==

== Trivia ==
* He was the top ranked Challenger player in Vietnam when recruited by [[Marines Esports]].
* Stark decided to retire from League career to continue his education at Da Nang University, but he later joined [[EVOS Esports]] in June 2017.
* Nicknamed "Emperor Stark" by fans.
